title: Added support for millisecond and second to gantt tickInterval
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

I have added `millisecond` and `second` to `tickInterval` for gantt charts. Hopefully I haven't missed anything, it seems to work based on my testing :)

![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/21963717/e08d06ed-f5bc-47c1-8ad4-905bbbf5f2b8)
```
---
displayMode: compact
---
gantt
dateFormat SSS
tickInterval 6millisecond
axisFormat %Lms
section Frame
    1: 000, 18ms
    2: 5ms
    3: 13ms
```

Resolves #4771

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Nothing worth considering.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

- No tests were added (I don't see any previous tickInterval tests)
- I haven't used MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION, if it's relevant please alter the PR.
author: vertxxyz

comments.author: tomperr
comments.body: This change did not automatically modify the `/docs/syntax/gantt.md` (at root) , did you forget to setup pre-commit?

comments.author: tomperr
comments.body: Also, this might be great to add `MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION` to specify from which version `millisecond` and `second` are available, but I also wonder if this feature is important enough to need to be specified

comments.author: vertxxyz
comments.body:
> This change did not automatically modify the `/docs/syntax/gantt.md` (at root) , did you forget to setup pre-commit?

Sorry, I am unfamiliar with this setup and don't know what pre-commit is (took a guess and ran `pnpm run pre-commit` and nothing changed).

> Also, this might be great to add MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION

There is a "Support: v10.3.0+" under that section which could be changed to: "Supported v10.3.0+, `millisecond` and `second` introduced v<MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION>+."

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
The pre-commit hooks should be setup automatically after pnpm install.

It won't do anything when you run pnpm pre-commit after committing files, as there will not be any changed files to be committed.

You can try running pnpm pre-commit after making some change in the docs file.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
```diff

+ ### Axis ticks (v10.3.0+)

-Support: v10.3.0+
+```warning

+```
 
```

You can use this diff
